latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the connectors-available skill.

- Tests which exchange connectors are accessible from your location.
- Allows searching for tokens and displays detailed trading rules (min order size, price increment, order types) across available exchanges.
- Provides scripts to test all or specific connectors.
- Saves results in trading_rules.json for easy reference.
- Requires running Hummingbot API and basic credentials setup.
